sources.snippet: Overview dinov2-base is a Vision Transformer (ViT) base-sized model trained using the DINOv2 self-supervised learning method, released by facebook. The model encodes images as sequences of fixed-size patches with linear embeddings, adds a [CLS] token for classification tasks, and includes absolute position embeddings before transformer encoder processing.
